questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Drive carefully and reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful as you go through the intersection. You do not need to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to watch for bicycles and other traffic crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a yellow-green background. These signs warn of upcoming sharp turns and curves in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round yellow signs with black markings warn about railroad crossings ahead. This is the only use for round warning signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic from another lane is about to join your lane. Be ready to move over safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a two-way road where traffic travels in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane need to merge into another lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic will be merging into your lane from the right. Be ready to make room if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means right turns are not allowed at this location. You must follow this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop. Then look all around before proceeding carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill. Slow down and control your speed carefully to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending and you are entering a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop. Let any traffic, cyclists, or pedestrians pass before you continue. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign is a traffic rule you must obey. Drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you are not allowed to enter, such as on one-way streets or the wrong direction of an expressway ramp.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to others drivers.
Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.
questions.explanation: A red left arrow means you must come to a complete stop before the intersection. Stay stopped while the red arrow is lit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Do not cross until it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mean you are near a school. Be alert for children and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yield means slow down and be ready to stop. After yielding to others, you can proceed with the remaining directions on the sign.
